Waste Removal

At Harris Waste Removal, we take the hassle out of getting rid of unwanted waste — whatever it is and wherever it is.

 

We handle all types of waste, including household junk, commercial clearances, garden waste, bulky items, white goods, and both hazardous and non-hazardous materials. Every load is handled responsibly, with waste sorted, recycled, or disposed of in full compliance with environmental regulations.

 

No skips, no waiting — just a fast, reliable collection when you need it. Whether you're a homeowner, landlord, or business, we've got you covered.

Get A Free Quote
Reliable Services Designed to Keep Your Property at Its Best

At Harris Waste Removal & Garden Services, we provide a wide range of reliable property services designed to make maintaining your home or business simple and stress-free. Whether you need unwanted waste cleared, outdoor spaces maintained, or help with moving and cleaning, our experienced team delivers efficient solutions with professional care and attention to detail.

Garden Maintenance

Keep your outdoor space looking its best all year round. Our garden maintenance service covers grass cutting, hedge trimming, weeding, pruning, turfing, and general garden tidying. Whether it's a one-off clear-up or a regular scheduled visit, we deliver a neat, well-kept finish every time. No garden is too overgrown or too large — we work with domestic and commercial properties alike.

Jet Washing

Bring your surfaces back to life with our high-pressure jet washing service. We clean driveways, patios, decking, pathways, fences, walls, and commercial hard-standing areas — removing years of grime, moss, algae, and staining. It's one of the quickest ways to transform the look of your property, and the results speak for themselves.

Cleaning Services

A thorough clean makes all the difference. We provide professional cleaning services for homes, rental properties, offices, and commercial spaces. From end-of-tenancy deep cleans to regular maintenance cleans, our team arrives fully equipped and leaves your space spotless. We take pride in the details — so you don't have to.

Man With a Van

Need something collected, delivered, or shifted? Our man with a van service is flexible, reliable, and priced fairly. Perfect for single item collections, eBay or marketplace pickups, furniture deliveries, or any job that doesn't need a full removal team. Available at short notice — just give us a call.

Painting Services

First impressions count. Our painting service covers interior and exterior work, including feature walls, full room repaints, fences, gates, and outbuildings. We use quality materials and work cleanly and efficiently, with minimal disruption to your day. Whether you're refreshing a single room or giving your property a full makeover, we deliver a clean, professional finish. Commericial or Domestic painting available.

Home Removals

Moving home doesn't have to be stressful. Our home removals service is designed to make your move as smooth and straightforward as possible. We handle everything from packing and loading to transport and unloading at your new address. Our team takes care with every item, treating your belongings as if they were our own. Local and regional moves covered — get in touch for a free quote.
